standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of cohomology of coherent sheaves on a proper scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes (cohomology of coherent sheaves on proper schemes is finite dimensional)
standard_prerequisites.use: Ensures the Euler characteristic is a finite alternating sum, so rank-nullity applies to the long exact sequence.

core_obligations: Write the long exact cohomology sequence associated to the short exact sequence, starting 0 -> H^0(F_1) -> H^0(F_2) -> H^0(F_3) -> H^1(F_1) -> ... (proof lines 6193-6197).
Apply the rank-nullity theorem level by level to obtain the alternating dimension identity 0 = dim H^0(F_1) - dim H^0(F_2) + dim H^0(F_3) - dim H^1(F_1) + ... (proof lines 6198-6203).
Rearrange the alternating sum into the additivity equality chi(F_2) = chi(F_1) + chi(F_3) (proof lines 6203-6204).
proof_roadmap: Record the long exact cohomology sequence of the short exact sequence.
Apply the alternating rank-nullity count to the dimensions.
Rearrange into the Euler characteristic additivity identity.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves additivity of the Euler characteristic chi(X, -) on a short exact sequence 0 -> F_1 -> F_2 -> F_3 -> 0 of coherent sheaves on a proper scheme X. The proof writes out the associated long exact cohomology sequence and applies the alternating rank-nullity count, which collapses to chi(F_2) = chi(F_1) + chi(F_3) (proof lines 6193-6204). H2: the linear-algebra bookkeeping over the (finite) cohomology sequence is the whole content; there is nothing routine to import from a single long exact sequence.
